question: Does the baryon-size-scaled diffusion length contain transferable information beyond an ordinary fixed physical smoothing width?
selection: Select the fixed physical width by development mean JSD only, then compare its locked holdout performance with the already locked P0592 q=0.5 propagator.
claim_limits: A fixed smoothing width is a descriptive null, not a dark-matter likelihood fit.
The source maps omit gas and ICL, so a failed adaptive scale can reflect an incomplete baryon map rather than failure of every nonlocal field.
